m-intro.text:
Intro motion: plays once, about 1.4 s
0 ms: horizon fades in. 260 ms (dur-base), ease-out.
160 ms: R, ı, s, e rise 10 px and fade in, 90 ms apart (dur-instant), 260 ms each (dur-base), ease-out.
260 ms: the sun rises from below the horizon. 520 ms (dur-slow), ease-out.
780 ms: the sun settles into the ı as its dot, small overshoot. 520 ms (dur-slow), ease-spring.
1040 ms: copy fades up 8 px. 260 ms (dur-base), ease-out.
1130 ms: Get started fades in. 260 ms (dur-base), ease-out.
Tap anywhere, or Get started, continues at any moment; nothing waits for the sequence. Reduced motion: durations are 0, the final frame shows at once. The seen flag is stored on the device.

m-wn.text:
What's new motion: plays once, about 1.1 s
0 ms: Today paints as usual, no card.
260 ms (dur-base delay): the card slot grows from 0 to full height, fades in and moves 12 px down into place. 520 ms (dur-slow), ease-out. Day total and blocks move down with it.
420 ms: title, four lines and Got it fade up 8 px, 90 ms apart (dur-instant), 260 ms each (dur-base), ease-out. Done at about 1.13 s.
Dismiss: Got it presses to .97 for 90 ms (dur-instant). The card fades, lifts 8 px and collapses over 260 ms (dur-base), ease-out; the day total slides up. No toast or Undo (Undo is for tick, weigh-in save and grocery Clear only).
Reduced motion: durations are 0, instant. Shown once, on the first Today after updating to 3.0; the seen flag is stored on the device.
